name: zinput_play_collision_impact_effect
description: zInputDI::PlayCollisionImpactEffect stops and restarts the CollisionImpact force-feedback effect with a camera-relative polar direction and gain clamped to [0.2, 1.0].
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded, and tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zInput force-feedback source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly and HLIL for 0x42fb50 validate thiscall self in ECX, CollisionImpact at self+0x0c, null-effect early return, Stop before descriptor setup, impact and camera X/Z atan2 bearings, relative polar wrap, direction scaled to hundredths of degrees, gain clamp to [0.2, 1.0], DIEFFECT dwSize 0x34, dwFlags 0x20, cAxes 2, rglDirection, SetParameters flags 0x44, and Start(1, 0).

The native force-feedback directional smoke verifies null effect no-op, Stop/SetParameters/Start sequencing, direction, descriptor flags, axis count, and low/high gain clamping through the collision-impact path.
